pullRequests.title: Match 508 functions, add a moby struct and functional C for the native port
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
This brings the fork's last stretch of work upstream. Progress goes from 3,706 to 4,214 of 5,109 functions (61.22% to 78.50% of the code), and complete units from 131 to 143.
Matches
Around 500 functions, most of them level functions in src/overlays. They come from three sources:

Our own near misses, finished off.
Lombyte's matched C, carried over by machine where the instructions are identical and every symbol is renamed to its PAL address.
Lombyte's C adapted where the US and PAL builds…

pullRequests.title: Port support: functional C for the native build, plus a handful of matching fixes
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: main
pullRequests.body:
Mostly port-side work: C the native PC build runs where the decomp is still
assembly or a near miss. None of it is counted as matched. Progress
reporting is unchanged apart from the regenerated report.
Functional C (nonmatching/functional/, listed in nonmatching/functional.tsv)

Level 0 gameplay: Ratchet's per-frame set and movement, the follow camera,
map setup, crate stacking init, the hero's hand attachments and items,
HeroEnvLighting and its zone searches, the wrench's lookups.
Menus: the…
